title: Play a Sucker to Catch a Sucker - Seem Dumber Than Your Mark
hook: The poker signal is quiet enough to miss and costly enough to matter.
counterintuition: Looking capable too early can make others guard themselves. Letting someone underestimate you can loosen their caution long enough to reveal the opening.
tryThisNow: Take the next request, update, or confrontation and mark where underestimation could misfire. Adjust the first move, not the final speech.
keyTakeaway: Lower the other person's guard by letting them feel mentally superior before the real move.
